mentions.name: MentalOS
mentions.description: A mental wellness tool that helps software engineers build their own 'MentalOS' to better manage emotions and feelings, aiming to smooth out the huge ups and downs caused by avoidance and poor emotional regulation.
mentions.problem: Good software engineers often struggle with emotion/feeling management and huge avoidance, leading to big ups and downs in their lives.
mentions.audience: Software engineers, particularly those who are neurodivergent and struggle with emotion and feeling management
mentions.source_excerpt:
My point to help to build your own MentalOS that works for, to live smoother lives without huge up and downs.
